transcript.text: Last year when I was in Shanghai, I remember I kept joking that I should’ve just rented a car the whole time instead of bouncing between taxis and the metro.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And then later I went to Chengdu too—same story there, except the parking situation was what everyone kept warning me about.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My coworker Wu Qian told me she’d already arranged a Toyota Corolla under her name for a pickup date of 2025-05-15, so I didn’t have to think about it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: She said the rental was for 6 days total, and honestly it sounded like it made the whole trip way smoother.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In Chengdu, my friend had already set up overnight parking at Chunxi Road IFS Parking starting 2025-04-02 17:00 for 12 hours—plate was 沪B67890, and the contact phone they used was 13898776655.
